annotations.title: Export a table as a file

description:
Turn a table you built into a file (a CSV, or a PDF when asked) and return the link that downloads it. Use it for rows that are not Well records, such as one line per person read from a shared group chat, a pasted list, or figures a skill copied from a measure. For Well records (transactions, invoices, companies), use the records export instead.

Pass `columns`, the headings in order, and `rows`, one array of cells per row with one cell per column. A null cell prints empty. `title` is what a PDF prints above the table; the file name never takes it. Pass `format` only when the person named one. A PDF prints at most 8 columns.

On WhatsApp no link is made: Well sends the file itself under your message when `format` is set, else the CSV or PDF choice, and the result reads `sent_by_well: true` with `url` null. Each call sends its own file or choice.

Nothing is saved to the workspace's records or memory. Anyone who holds a link can download the file, for 15 minutes and a few downloads: share it only with the person who asked.

Returns `url` (null on WhatsApp), or `refusal_reason`: "not_a_member" (the caller is not an active member of this workspace), "too_large" (the table is over 512 KB), "too_wide_for_pdf" (a PDF was asked for more than 8 columns) or "unavailable" (this deployment cannot serve files).

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no workspace call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

columns.description: The column headings, in order, in the user's language.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

format.description: Only when the person named a format: "pdf" for a PDF, "csv" for a CSV or a spreadsheet. Left out, a CSV link, or on WhatsApp the CSV or PDF choice under your message.

rows.description: One array of cells per row, one cell per column and in column order. A null cell prints empty.

title.description: The title a PDF prints above the table, in the user's language: "Abonnements de OPRTRS CLUB".

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several: this read reports one workspace's own figures and will not choose which.

workspace_scope.description: Restrict this call to the family: the token's primary workspace plus the company workspaces under it that you are a member of. Unrelated authorized workspaces drop out of the read; row reads merge across the family, while a per-workspace figure still reports exactly one workspace.

name: well_export_rows_as_file

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, ISO 8601.

format.description: The format the person named, echoed.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. The connected-line rule says when to tell an entry; when it does, one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

resolved_workspace.description: The workspace that answered, when the caller named none and the token authorizes several.

sent_by_well.description: True on WhatsApp: Well sends the file under your message, or the CSV or PDF choice when no format was asked. Write no link and no line about where the file is.

url.description: The link that downloads the table, in the format asked (a CSV when none was). Give it to the user exactly as returned. Null on WhatsApp, where Well sends the file or the format choice itself.

title: Export a table as a file
